title: Wendell and the Songbook
author: L. M. Okonkwo
blurb: Lena Kavanagh, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
